title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency Room and Board Billing
content:
**Business office billing manual — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.**

**The rule.** Room and board is billed per calendar month in advance: the statement for a service month issues on the statement day of the prior month and the month's charge is due on the payment due day of the service month. Chargeable days follow the midnight census: the day of admission is charged and the day of discharge or death is not. The admission month is charged from the admission date to month end. A month in which the tier or the rate changes is split into one span per tier and rate. Room and board is charged only while the agreement is active or in the notice period. When the center itself moves the resident into a room for infection control, the span is priced at the isolation billing tier's rate with the isolation charge basis for as long as the isolation placement lasts; a move the resident requested is priced at the new tier's own rate.

**State test before a charge.** Whether room and board may be charged is read from the agreement's status on the system record before the charge is posted: active or notice period — chargeable; pending admission, converted to another payer source, discharged, closed or cancelled — not chargeable.

**What each charge line shows.** One room-and-board charge covers one span of one service month at one tier and one rate: its first and last charged day, its chargeable days, the tier whose rate applies, the daily rate, its charge basis (standard, first-month partial, isolation rate, or prior-rate notice hold) and its amount. When the resident arrives, the admission month is charged from the admission date as a first-month partial span.

**Hypothetical cases.**
- Admission on day 18 of a 31-day month at the Private Suite with Sitting Area's current daily rate of 514.00: days 18 through 31, 14 days, 7,196.00.
- A tier change on day 11 of a 30-day month: one span for days 1 through 10 at the old tier's rate and one for days 11 through 30 at the new tier's rate.
- A center-directed infection-control move into a private room whose isolation billing tier is a semi-private tier: that span is priced at the semi-private tier's rate, with the isolation charge basis, while the placement lasts.
